data.claim: A ddflow review --detach relaunches the review WITHOUT the resolved agent identity, so the detached process runs as a freshly derived id that holds no lease; the lease keeper finds the holder does not match and never renews, so the lease lapses over the TTL.
data.falsifier: The relaunched argv already carries --agent <resolved>, or the lease is renewed despite a different derived id.
data.mechanism: review._detach relaunches the review via _relaunch_argv, which strips only --detach and does not re-declare the resolved --agent id, so the detached process re-derives its id; api/review/run.py wires on_tick=keep_lease but leasekeep.keeper returns None when the holder does not match log.agent_id, so no lease.renewed lands.
data.question: Why does a held lease lapse during long detached review rounds?

evidence.note: R4cb3a26d10 CONFIRMED: the detached relaunch does not re-declare the resolved --agent id, so the detached review runs as a derived id holding no lease and renews nothing
read r-adapters, r-gemini-key-load, r-lease/claim rules via gate status guidance; commit_without_lease=block enforced; widest globs updated
redeclared the resolved identity in _detach_argv; regression test in tests/test_review_detach.py; commit 8dac8bb72

chunk_findings.detail: `_detach_argv` always returns at least `["--agent", agent]`, so the subsequent `if not argv:` guard is now dead. For a call where `getattr(a, "_argv", [])` is empty, or where the only argument is `--detach`, the old `_relaunch_argv` returned `[]` and `_detach` returned `FAIL`; the new code instead launches a detached job whose command is `python -m ddflow --agent <id>` with no review verb/task. That detached job cannot perform the intended review and bypasses the explicit “needs the review's own arguments to relaunch” contract.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/surfaces/commands/review.py:_detach

chunk_findings.detail: The regression test exercises only the pure helper `_detach_argv`; it never calls `_detach`, mocks `_launch_job`, or checks any lease/heartbeat state. It would still pass if `_detach` were reverted to `argv = _relaunch_argv(...)` or if the job launcher were reverted to `agent=c.requested_agent`, because the helper itself remains unchanged. The actual bug is that the detached round must renew the holder’s lease, and no test demonstrates that the launched detached review carries the holder identity or that the lease is extended.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_review_detach.py:test_detach_argv_redeclares_the_resolved_identity_so_the_round_renews_the_lease

chunk_findings.detail: `_detach_argv` always returns a non-empty list (`["--agent", agent, ...]`) even when the original argv had no arguments to relaunch. In `_detach`, the existing guard `if not argv:` is now dead. For example, with `_argv == ["--detach"]` and `c.log.agent_id == "role"`, `_detach_argv` returns `["--agent", "role"]`, so `_detach` does not print `--detach needs the review's own arguments to relaunch` and does not return `FAIL`; it proceeds to launch a detached review with no review arguments.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/surfaces/commands/review.py:_detach

chunk_findings.detail: Only the exact `--agent <value>` token pair is removed; the standard argparse `--agent=<value>` form is not. Given `_detach_argv(["--detach", "--agent=shell-alias", "T1"], "role")`, it returns `["--agent", "role", "--agent=shell-alias", "T1"]`. Argparse keeps the last occurrence of `--agent`, so the detached review runs as `shell-alias` instead of the resolved holder `role`, and the holder's lease is still not renewed.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/surfaces/commands/review.py:_detach_argv

chunk_findings.detail: The “regression test” only asserts the output of the new `_detach_argv` helper. On the unfixed code it fails solely because `_detach_argv` does not exist, not because the lease actually expires. After adding the helper, the test passes even if `_detach` still passed the requested alias to `_start` or the detached round never heartbeated, so it is not a regression test for bug B-lease-ttl-expires-during-review.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_review_detach.py:test_detach_argv_redeclares_the_resolved_identity_so_the_round_renews_the_lease
